description: Price move needed to cover funding cost + fees over a holding period. Edge cases: entry_price, size and hold_hours above zero; funding_rate is a decimal per funding interval (0.0001 is 0.01%), either sign; funding_interval_hours 0.25 to 24 (default 8); fees are fractions from 0 to 0.05. If carry cost exceeds what any price move can offset, the call is an error. Not covered: a funding rate that changes during the hold, mark versus last price, and slippage. Use when user asks "how much does BTC need to move for me to profit after funding?" or "is funding killing my edge on this trade?". Returns: breakevenWithFunding, breakevenWithoutFunding, requiredMovePct.

contractType.description: linear = USDT-margined (default), inverse = coin-margined. size is USD notional (contracts) for inverse; notional/funding_cost/fee_total/total_carry_cost come back denominated in the base coin.

funding_interval_hours.description: Hours per funding payment, the period funding_rate covers: 8 (default), 1 on Hyperliquid, dYdX, Kraken and Backpack (per-hour rates), 4 or 2 on some symbols of Binance, Bybit, OKX, Gate, KuCoin, MEXC, Aster and Phemex

funding_rate.description: Funding rate per funding interval as a DECIMAL FRACTION, not a percent: 0.0001 means 0.01%, so a quoted 0.0125% is 0.000125
